source_text.body:
Find an NYC apartment with a listing-watching agent
Andrew Kordampalos built an agent with Zapier and Vercel for about $20 to find an NYC apartment, saying it did; replies questioned its inventory.
·
May 4, 2026
Done with
ZA
Zapier Agents
What they did
Andrew built an AI agent to find an NYC apartment. The post states that the agent did so, with no further mechanics described.
How it went
The agent found an apartment. Replies questioned the inventory source and suggested the claim might be made up.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Build me an agent that watches [listing site or email alerts] for new apartments in [city or neighborhood] under [max rent] with [bedrooms] bedrooms and [must-haves]. Each time it finds a match, have it check that the listing is still live and send me a short summary with the link by [email or Slack]. Don't contact any landlord or send replies on my behalf; stop once the alerts are running and send me a test alert.
Original source: https://x.com/ckor/status/2051310336980947305
